careers.title: Careers | OBM Construction S.C.
careers.description: Explore open roles and a career at OBM Construction S.C. — an Ethiopian construction company built on safety, quality and integrity.
careers.heroDescription: Join a team that shapes Ethiopia's built environment with safety, quality and integrity.
careers.whyObmTitle: Work that shows up in the skyline.
careers.whyObmDescription: We're growing our team of engineers, project leaders and site professionals who are proud of what they build.
careers.openPositionsDescription: We're looking for people who take pride in doing the job properly.
careers.benefitsDescription: We invest in the people who build for us.

opening.description: Apply to work with OBM Construction S.C.
opening.closedNotice: This vacancy has closed and is no longer accepting applications.
opening.notFoundDesc: This vacancy may have been filled or withdrawn. Browse the current openings instead.
opening.speculativeDescription: Tell us the position you are applying for and we will get back to you.
opening.cvHint: PDF, DOC or DOCX. Up to 8 MB.
opening.certificatesHint: Optional. PDF, DOC, DOCX, JPG or PNG. Up to 10 MB.
opening.consent: I confirm the information above is accurate and consent to OBM Construction S.C. storing my details for recruitment purposes.
opening.successDescription: Thank you for applying. Our recruitment team reviews every application and will contact shortlisted candidates.
opening.errorMessage: Your application could not be submitted. Please check the form and try again.
